title: checkout-oom-after-helm-limit-cut
summary: Helm values reduced memory limits for checkout-api from 1Gi to 256Mi. Pods OOMKilled under peak cart traffic; error rate spiked for 18 minutes.
root_cause: memory limit set below real steady-state usage after busy-hour load

title: hpa-maxreplicas-starved-cluster
summary: Helm chart raised HPA maxReplicas for search-api from 10 to 200. Autoscale event during sale caused node pool exhaustion and kubelet pressure cluster-wide.
symptoms: Pending pods, DiskPressure, elevated scheduling latency
root_cause: HPA maxReplicas unbounded relative to cluster capacity
blast_radius: search-api, shared node pool, unrelated namespaces

title: pdb-blocked-node-drain-during-upgrade
summary: New PodDisruptionBudget minAvailable=100% on payments-gateway blocked node drains. Cluster upgrade stalled; old nodes flapped and connection resets rose.
symptoms: drain timeout, Eviction blocked by PDB, elevated TCP resets
root_cause: PDB too strict for rolling node replacement

title: networkpolicy-denied-redis-after-helm-sync
summary: Helm release added default-deny NetworkPolicy without allowing egress to Redis. Orders service could not reach cache; latency and timeouts cascaded.
symptoms: i/o timeout to redis, connection refused from policy drop
root_cause: NetworkPolicy missing egress to Redis CIDR/port

title: image-tag-latest-pulled-breaking-build
summary: Deployment image was :latest. Overnight rebuild of base image broke inventory-worker; CrashLoop after deploy with no chart version change.
root_cause: mutable latest tag instead of digest or immutable semver

title: rollingupdate-maxunavailable-too-high
summary: Helm set rollingUpdate maxUnavailable=50% on storefront Deployment. Half the pods terminated at once during release; CDN origin errors during Valentine peak.
symptoms: 503 from ingress, ready replicas dropped sharply

title: configmap-hot-reload-bad-json
summary: ConfigMap mounted into auth-service updated with invalid JSON feature flags. App hot-reloaded and all pods started failing auth token validation.
symptoms: 401 storm, config parse errors, all replicas unhealthy
root_cause: invalid ConfigMap applied via Helm without schema validation

title: ingress-tls-secret-mismatch
summary: Helm Ingress pointed tls.secretName to rotated secret that was not yet created in namespace. TLS handshake failures for api.example.com.
symptoms: SSL_ERROR, default backend cert served, customer TLS alerts
root_cause: Ingress TLS secret name out of sync with Secret resource

title: initcontainer-wait-for-migrate-hung
summary: Helm chart added initContainer waiting for migrate Job. Job failed silently; new Pods stuck in Init forever; old ReplicaSet scaled down → outage.
root_cause: init dependency on failed Job with no timeout/backoff UX

title: resourcequota-blocked-new-pods
summary: Namespace ResourceQuota CPU was lowered via Helm umbrella chart. Deployments could not schedule new pods during rollout; old pods terminated first.
symptoms: forbidden: exceeded quota, Deployment progress deadline
root_cause: ResourceQuota too low for surge pods during RollingUpdate

title: servicemonitor-scrape-storm
summary: Helm values enabled ServiceMonitor with 5s scrape and huge metric cardinality for checkout. Prometheus memory ballooned; alert evaluation delayed.
symptoms: Prometheus OOM, rule evaluation lag, missing alerts

title: helm-hook-pre-upgrade-deleted-pvc-data
summary: pre-upgrade Helm hook Job ran a cleanup that deleted PVCs labeled app=analytics. StatefulSet lost volumes; dashboards blank after upgrade.
symptoms: PVC Terminating, empty PersistentVolume claims, data loss
root_cause: destructive Helm hook without dry-run guard

title: nodeaffinity-pinned-to-draining-pool
summary: Deployment required nodeAffinity to gpu-spot pool. Spot interruption drained nodes; pods could not reschedule elsewhere; inference API down.
root_cause: hard affinity to interruptible pool without fallback

title: sidecar-injection-cpu-throttle
summary: Istio sidecar injection enabled via Helm label change. Sidecar default CPU limits starved app containers; p99 latency tripled.
symptoms: CPU throttling, high p99, envoy proxy busy
root_cause: sidecar resource defaults not tuned for latency-critical service

title: cronjob-concurrency-policy-forbid-backlog
summary: CronJob concurrencyPolicy=Forbid with long-running job. Missed schedules piled up; when job finished, manual catch-up overloaded DB.
symptoms: missed CronJob schedules, DB connection spikes later
root_cause: Forbid + long runtime without monitoring missed runs

title: liveness-probe-too-aggressive-after-chart-change
summary: Helm lowered liveness probe timeoutSeconds and period. Slow JVM warmup caused kubelet to kill pods repeatedly during rollout.
symptoms: Liveness probe failed, restart thrash, rollout stuck
root_cause: liveness probe tighter than startup characteristics

title: horizontal-pod-disruption-during-vpa-update
summary: VPA in updateMode=Auto resized recommendations mid-traffic. Pods restarted en masse; recommendation service flapped.
symptoms: mass restarts, InPlaceOrRecreate events, error budget burn
root_cause: VPA Auto mode on latency-sensitive Deployment

title: service-selector-mismatch-after-label-rename
summary: Helm chart renamed pod labels but Service selector not updated. Endpoints emptied; notifications silently dropped.
symptoms: Endpoints empty, Service no pods, traffic blackhole
root_cause: label selector drift between Service and Pod template
